title: Layer gate arguments precede its layer
statement: Let $F$ be a finite layered Boolean circuit whose gates use only identity, NOT, and unbounded fan-in AND operations. If $m$ is below the depth of $F$ and $u$ is a node in the successor of layer $m$, then every argument vertex of the gate associated with $u$ in layer $m$ has index strictly less than $n$ plus the cumulative number of nodes in the successor layers preceding layer $m$.
hypotheses_covered: $F$ is a layered circuit over $\mathrm{Fin}\,2$ with $n$ inputs and output type $\mathrm{Unit}$
Every gate operation of $F$ is identity, NOT, or unbounded fan-in AND
$u$ is a node in the successor of layer $m$
The argument vertex is an element of the associated gate's argument list
